Founder message

Blake Built became a reality 25 years ago. My vision was to bring custom craftsmanship to my clients. The old adage of “you get what you pay for” is so true. I see my projects through. I quote them, work with my client throughout the process, and I am the only contractor on site. I stand behind my work and guarantee satisfaction.

In the end, my vision, once again- became a reality and your vision was brought to life.

There is no job either too big, or too small, and I guarantee your experience with me will be a great one.

Blake Built’s uniqueness to visions breathe is allowances are subtracted and returned to client to provide all finished materials of color for their vision to come to life not trends.

Enjoy your project from start to finish with one professional instead of watching several trades walking in and out of your home. You will have one person to hold accountable versus experiencing passing the buck. Let me show you my enthusiasm, passion, creativity, dedication, and experience.

This is how I make visions breathe.Fred Blake

We do projects with

Homeowners

Whether you’re a homeowner who’s ready to upgrade an old kitchen or a homebuyer who wants to plan the build before purchasing, we are equipped and ready to make those visions a reality.

Realtors

Successful realtors never list properties that are just near perfect. Blake Built can certainly repair and ready the properties to perfection before you get them listed.

Mobile Home Owners

These manufactured and mobile homes need some tender loving care from time to time. We take great care in repairing, power-washing, rescuing, and remodeling mobile homes.

Our services

We are well-versed in renovation and remodeling projects for houses and mobile homes. You cannot go wrong with our more than 25 years of experience. If you have a project in mind, we invite you to give us a call to open the discussion.

General cost expectations*

*Without subtracted allowance

Premium Kitchen Remodel

$36,000-$56,000

This includes demolition and disposal/recycling of all materials, high end cabinets, quartz or granite countertops, new sinks and faucets, backsplash, paint, flooring and higher end finishes.

Typical Bathroom Remodel

$13,000-$24,000

This includes demolition and disposal/recycling of all materials, new showers/bathtubs and toilets, plumbing updated, flooring and tile work, new vanity, baseboards, paint, new lighting, and all finishing.

Typical Kitchen Renovation

$21,000-$36,000

This includes demolition and disposal/recycling of all materials. Boxed flat pack cabinets, quartz countertops, new sinks and faucets, backsplash, paint, flooring, and all finishing.
